webster.text: Pertaining to a province or relating to it; as a provincial government; a provincial dialect.

more.text: Not polished; rude; as provincial accent or manners.
Pertaining to an ecclesiastical province, or to the jurisdiction of an archbishop; not ecumenical; as a provincial synod.
A person belonging to a province.

example.quote: They have authority to appoint and receive ambassadors; to execute treaties and alliances already formed; to provide for the collection of duties on imports and exports; to regulate the mint, with a saving to the provincial rights; to govern as sovereigns the dependent territories.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 20 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 11, 1787
